description: This file defines a report parser class for the 'account.analytic.journal' report in Odoo, including methods to fetch and sum analytic journal data within a date range.

classes.name: account_analytic_journal
classes.description: A report parser class for generating analytic journal reports in Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser with context-specific data and functions.

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Fetches account move lines associated with a specific journal and date range.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Fetches analytic lines associated with a specific move, journal, and date range.

methods.name: _sum_general
methods.description: Calculates the sum of debit minus credit for move lines within a date range and journal.

methods.name: _sum_analytic
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of analytic lines within a date range and journal.
